notes.title: Yohjo Simulator Working Update Schedule
notes.notes:
Development of Yohjo Simulator is still going on. Over the next year Deadfactory has planned the following timeline of updates for the game. 

Mid April
◯Basic update
Improved parkour
Time attack mode
Taunting
◯Wave Rage Update
New costume [Lucky Sailor] allowing you to drift on the ocean
New Map [Dock 16]
Cannot sink

End of June
Tokyo Update
New Costume [Shibuya style] allowing you to perform a new move.
New Map Hohnan street. Suginami ward now here along with Shibuya ward.
Radios now have rockin' beats.

End of August
◯School Life Simulator Update
New Costume Anti-Zombie Swimsuit, allows you to attack the decaying strangers
New Map Ikagawa Elementary School  
Score Attack mode 
Electrifying.

End of October
Halloween update
New Costume Little Witch Climax, allows you to summon something.
New map Obake Street
Kamaboko

Opening of 2017
◯Yohjo Simulator Update
New costume Ordinary Yohjo

Deadfactory would love to hear from the community to help improve his game from the ground up. He's asking for suggestions and anything you feel would help the game is welcome.

Please note these dates are tentative and subject to change.
